title: Struct Field Peek
goal: Read one field without paying for it - and without breaking the struct.
hints: Moving the field out (profile.name) is a partial move - the struct is then broken for &profile.
You can borrow a single field: the reference reaches through the struct.
explanation: Three ways to read a field: clone it (works, allocates), move it out (a partial move - profile can no longer be borrowed whole, so show(&profile) dies with E0382), or borrow it. `&profile.name` borrows just the field, costs nothing, and leaves the struct intact for the later call. Field borrows are precise: the borrow checker tracks them per-field.
